description: This file defines the OAuthConfig interface, providing configuration settings for OAuth, including protocols and issuer mappings.

classes.name: OAuthConfig
classes.description: An interface providing configuration settings for OAuth.

methods.name: getProtocol
methods.description: Returns the protocol to access all OAuth endpoints.

methods.name: getOpenIdConnectIssuers
methods.description: Returns all supported OpenID Connect issuers.

methods.name: getOpenIdConnectIssuersExtension
methods.description: Returns additional supported OpenID Connect issuers, useful during migration phases.
